Name: Simon the Tanner
Summary: Simon the Tanner lived at Joppa by the sea, and Peter lodged at his house while the Lord prepared him to receive Cornelius, the Gentile centurion.
KeyStory: Peter stayed with Simon the Tanner while a sheet from heaven taught him to call no man unclean.
LifeLesson: God prepared Peter for the Gentiles in a tanner's house, a trade the law counted unclean. The lesson began before the vision.
